segments.name: Hong Kong Trading
segments.description: Distributes reflective and non-reflective garment trims to international apparel brands from Hong Kong.
segments.evidence: Mainly through our HK Operating Subsidiary, we are an established distributor in Hong Kong of reflective and non-reflective garment trims including, among others, heat transfers, fabrics, woven labels and tapes, sewing badges, piping, zipper pulls and drawcords.

segments.name: Vietnam Manufacturing
segments.description: Runs a manufacturing plant in Vietnam through subsidiary J-Long Trims Vietnam Co., Ltd.
segments.evidence: We are an established distributor in Hong Kong of reflective and non-reflective garment trims including, among others, heat transfers, fabrics, woven labels and tapes, sewing badges, piping, zipper pulls and drawcords, with a manufacturing plant in Vietnam.

revenueModel.text: International apparel brands pay for garment trims and related services such as product design, development, and production and quality control.
revenueModel.evidence: We offer a wide range of services to cater to our customers' needs in reflective and non-reflective garment trims, including market trend analysis, product design and development, and production and quality control.

changes.text: Segments changed from one segment in 2024 to two reportable segments, Hong Kong Trading and Vietnam Manufacturing, in 2025.
changes.evidence: And there was only one segment for the year ended March 31, 2024.
